mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.1% is at a historically low level, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a very low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) and a high unemployment rate (above 7.0%) signals a severe economic downturn, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary easing cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the Federal Reserve's accommodative policy reduces risk-free rates and increases liquidity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances within monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 700 thousand units, it indicates a contraction in the housing sector, reducing consumer confidence and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 700.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 96.0 (2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 96.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of rising retail sales (above 400,000 million dollars) and falling housing starts (below 700 thousand units) indicates a weak consumer demand environment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS > 400000.0 AND HOUST < 700.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
